in_marathi.name: Kshipra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshipra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kshipra is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kshipra’, which means ‘sprout’, ‘shoot’, or ‘quick’. This name is often given to girls born during the monsoon season when new growth is abundant. In Hindu mythology, Kshipra is the name of a celestial river that flows from the heavens to the earth. It is said to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune.
